# hub-show

The hub as the show clock: the show player, live audio to a speaker, saved shows by name, stop-all.

## Rules and traps

- One player per hub; a page that asked to be watched and goes silent 4 s stops the arm (A26-46).
- A pose with no reply is counted, not fatal: MAX_MISSES in a row ends the show
  and stops its song. One lost reply used to end it mid-song (check_show_misses).
